# Anjo Sleep

> Each person gets their own LoRA adapter on Muse Glimmer 30B, trained on them every night, plus
> MIND, a small trained model that puts odds on what a person will do. Both were scored once against
> pre-registered pass marks on held-out simulated people. Research preview v0.1.0, built for the Meta
> Global AI Developer Hackathon (October 27 to November 4, 2026).

To check every headline number offline: `git fetch origin prereg && python -m anjo.sleep.tools.verify_claims`.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): repo map, the claim to evidence to ledger table, how to run, limitations
- [README.md](README.md): what it does, results, architecture, how to run it live
- [RESULTS.md](anjo/sleep/RESULTS.md): every run, including the failed ones and why
- [SAFETY.md](SAFETY.md): what is switched off, what still guards a person, what the results don't show

## Evidence

- [Claim checker](anjo/sleep/tools/verify_claims.py): ledger chain, score hashes, MIND hashes
- [Ledger code](anjo/sleep/prereg/ledger.py): the hash chain; the entries are on the `prereg` branch
- [Sleep final scores](anjo/sleep/results/): `*/scores/final.json`, ledger seq 92 to 94
- [MIND held-out test](anjo/sleep/mind/cog/heldout/prereg_mind_heldout.md): pre-registration; scores in `score/SCORES.json`

## Code

- [One night](anjo/sleep/night/run.py): `run_night`, the stages in order
- [Training recipe](anjo/sleep/train/): QLoRA, 4-bit NF4, rank 32, attention + MLP
- [Gates](anjo/sleep/gates/): general skills, collapse, safety
- [Standalone example](anjo/sleep/examples/synthetic/): `python -m anjo.sleep.examples.synthetic --fake`
